Multiple Bus Accidents Kill at Least 10 Across India

Two separate bus accidents have resulted in multiple fatalities across India. In Kerala's Thrissur district, a speeding private bus collided with four vehicles, killing two women and injuring at least 24 people. In Himachal Pradesh's Chamba district, a bus carrying passengers overturned and fell off a mountain road, killing seven people and injuring 11. Rescue operations in Himachal Pradesh involved NDRF, Police, Home Guards, Fire Services, and the Revenue Department. Prime Minister Modi and Chief Minister Sukhu expressed condolences for the Himachal accident.
